result:
Round 298 is planned, but it is not STUDIO-LINK-b. It is a small tests-only fix, and "View in store" moves to round 299.

**Round 297 result:** C passed all 9 rows, and the real browser was checked (cold deep link at both viewports, plus the sign-in check). Gate 297 published `77d5341` to both remotes. STUDIO-LINK-a2 is now marked done (მზადაა). I updated the backlog only from that C and gate evidence. The round-297 task is copied to `tasks/round-297.md`.

**Why the scope changed:** the gate-297 reviewer found that LH3's "no hydration mismatch" check can never fail. React prints only one mismatch warning per page load, and LH1, which runs first in the same file, uses it up.
- I reproduced it at HEAD: a mutant that gives a library option a different attribute on server and client still leaves all 4 LH rows green.
- With LH3 alone in its own file, the same mutant turns it red.
- I rule this Medium, the same as the similar finding last round. The bug gate fixes Medium findings before new features, so it goes first.
- I briefly got this wrong: my first mutant used a `typeof window` check, which does nothing in the test environment, so the split looked useless. With a valid mutant it works.

**Round 298 (STUDIO-LINK-a3, tests only, 3 files, no app code):**
- LH3 moves to a new file, `studio-link-hydrate-ssr-ui.test.tsx`.
- The warning filter is narrowed, so a harmless server-only warning no longer counts.
- Every test cleans up its rendered page, even when it fails.
- Doc 220 is corrected: it no longer claims "no hydration warning", and it says STUDIO-LINK-b is round 299.
- I pre-ran all of this on a throwaway copy with its own cache. 7 test files and 58 tests pass, and typecheck and lint are clean. Each mutant turns its row red: the mismatch mutant LH3, removing the prop LH1 and LH3, removing the settle line LH4, and undoing the reordering LH3.
- C will also run the cold deep link in the real browser at both viewports and the sign-in check.

**Not fixed this round:** the video player's `muted` attribute differs between server and client. It doesn't affect users, but it uses up React's one warning, so hydration tests only catch mismatches in parts that load before the video area. The library is one of those parts. I recorded it as a deferred Low; adding `suppressHydrationWarning` to the two video tags removed the warning on the throwaway copy.

**For round 299:** the product-designer advice and the Ableton Live 12 manual reference (§4.7.3.3, a sample's right-click menu can "view the sample's pack") are saved in `b-round-297/product-designer-studio-link-b.md`. The design is a one-item right-click menu, "View in store", that opens the product page in a new tab. Products not in the store keep the browser's normal menu, and the `?` sheet gets one row. A `?preview=` link only takes effect on first load.

**Decision:** CONTINUE. It isn't COMPLETE because most of the planned work and every deferred Low are still open. It isn't BLOCKED because nothing external is missing. The regression round is due on or after 2026-11-02, and the retrospective is at round 305. The advisor was available, and I consulted it before writing and before finishing. The store code was not touched.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- b-round-297.md
- b-next.json
- backlog.json
- feature-status.md
